reason: D-0058: zero-action retire/replace job-permission card revisions reach Telegram without card identity (the wiring drops callbackKey/revision that the outbox payload already carries), so settlement cannot mark the card retired and a delayed older action revision can re-arm it. Pass the identity through MessageSendOptions and settle zero-action edits against the card. Scope: domain/types.ts, job-permission-wiring-setup.ts, telegram channel-delivery.ts (+card delivery), telegram.test.ts.

quality.summary: Zero-action card revisions now settle against the card in Telegram. Lite window Q-0081 (base 6e3ab9b31 -> HEAD), D-0058: wiring passes MessageSendOptions.jobPermissionCardRevision (callbackKey/revision/operation already in the outbox payload); Telegram generic replace path settles zero-action retire edits against the card (idempotent, lane-bound, recorded). Replace notice carries no identity (new card settles). Proof: channels 41/987 + jobperm-edges green, tsc, architecture, verify.py passed.
